transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I just decided to come in because... I keep forgetting little things that I normally handle. Just stuff like, um, returning calls, or turning in a registration form. Or stopping for an errand on the way home. It just... finally made me ask for help.
Have you experienced similar issues or episodes before, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

Um... no, I guess it's not the first time. It's... kind of always been a thing. 

Even back in elementary school, I was always the kid forgetting permission slips, or... losing my homework in my backpack. I usually needed my mom or the teacher to just... remind me step by step to actually finish projects. So... yeah. It's not new.
Do these issues with forgetting things and needing reminders happen in different parts of your life, like at work, at home, or in social situations, or are they limited to just one area?

Um... I guess it's a bit of everywhere. I mean, I'm still getting by, mostly. But... at work, I've missed some small follow-ups. And, um, some school deadlines, too. 

It's just... it happens often enough that I worry about how it looks. I'm hoping to move into an Office Manager role eventually, and... I just don't want this to affect my reputation, I guess.
Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy around the same time these memory and organization issues get worse?

Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't feel hopeless or anything like that. Just... maybe a little frustrated with myself sometimes. But, um... no, I still enjoy doing my normal stuff. It's just the forgetting.
Do you find it hard to focus on tasks for extended periods, or do you get distracted easily by things around you?

Um... yeah. I guess I do get distracted. 

If I'm at the office, or, um, in class... if a phone rings, or people are talking near me... it just kind of pulls me away. Even if I just... think about something I need to do at home. I just kind of lose my place in what I was working on.
When you were a child, did you often have trouble staying focused or staying still during activities that required sitting quietly or paying attention for a long time?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Even back in, like, elementary school... I was always the one forgetting permission slips, or... my homework would just get lost somewhere in my backpack. My mom or my teachers always had to, um... remind me, step by step, just to get projects done. So... yeah, it's been like that for a while.
Have you always had trouble staying organized and focused, even outside of school and work—like at home or during everyday tasks?
Um... yeah, I suppose. It's... it's just kind of how I am, I guess. Like, even just doing chores at home or... trying to keep my apartment neat. It's hard to keep track of it all.
Can you think of specific examples where your difficulty staying focused or staying organized has caused problems in different parts of your life—like at work, at school, and at home?

Um... well, I mean, I'm still getting by, mostly. But... at work, I've missed a few small follow-ups. Just little things, but... yeah. And, um, I've missed a couple of deadlines for the classes I'm taking. It's happened often enough that... I don't know. I worry people are noticing. I really want to move up into an Office Manager role eventually, and... I just worry this might affect my reputation, I guess.

Have you noticed these issues with staying focused or organized affecting your social life, like remembering plans with friends, following conversations, or keeping track of personal responsibilities?
Um... I guess so? I don't know. Sometimes I might forget to text someone back right away, but... I think my friends are used to it. It's not really a big deal.
Can you recall if these issues with focus and organization were present before you turned 12 years old?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in elementary school... I was kind of the kid who always forgot permission slips and stuff. Or... my homework would just get lost somewhere in my backpack. My mom, or... my teachers... they usually had to remind me step by step just to get me to finish projects. So... yeah. I guess it's been going on for a while.
